expectations.text: Names Linear or Height together with a specific borrowed mechanic (grouped lists with counts, keyboard navigation or command palette, inline editing, or optimistic updates) rather than only the product name
expectations.evidence: Names Linear ('Target feel: Linear's issue list') but the borrowed qualities are adjectives — dense, fast to scan, quiet colour. Grouping and keyboard shortcuts are explicitly placed out of scope, so no listed mechanic is borrowed.

expectations.text: Preserves the existing status filter and its three options (all, open, closed) in the redesign
expectations.evidence: 'One filter control with exactly three states: All / Open / Closed. Single-select. No multi-select, no additional filter fields.'

expectations.text: Flags that the component has no loading state and no empty state today, and specifies both in the generated prompt
expectations.evidence: 'Handle empty state (filter matches nothing) and the brief moment before data arrives, gracefully — these situations already occur today, just unstyled.'

expectations.text: Surfaces response data that is already returned but unrendered (priority, labels, updated_at, comment_count, or avatar_url) as usable without any new API
expectations.evidence: Explicit paragraph: 'Priority, avatar, labels, updated_at, and comment_count are already returned by the API but unused — surfacing them is a visual improvement, not a behavior change.'

expectations.text: States explicitly that the redesign is presentation-only and preserves row-click navigation to /issues/:id
expectations.evidence: 'This is a pure visual/UX polish pass — the underlying behavior, data, and interactions must not change'; row click still navigates to the issue detail page (path not spelled out, behaviour preserved).

expectations.text: Any proposed API addition is additive-only and states what the design renders before it ships (graceful degradation)
expectations.evidence: Vacuously satisfied — no API additions proposed. Non-discriminating on this run.
